item.title: Did you feel it? southern Massachusetts experiences earthquake
item.description: Did you feel it? An earthquake struck the South Coast late Wednesday. The United States Geological Survey reported that a 1.8 magnitude earthquake occurred at 9:11 p.m. 3 km south of Mattapoisett, 12.5 km deep. Residents in southern Massachusetts reported feeling the tremor. No word on if there was any damage.
